title: Restaurant Growth Moving Average
prompt: Compute the 7-day moving sum and average of customer payments. Return visited_on, amount, and average_amount for days with a complete 7-day window.
expected_query: WITH daily AS (SELECT visited_on, SUM(amount) AS daily_amount FROM customer GROUP BY visited_on), windowed AS (SELECT visited_on, SUM(daily_amount) OVER (ORDER BY visited_on ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS amount, ROUND(AVG(daily_amount) OVER (ORDER BY visited_on ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS average_amount, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY visited_on) AS rn FROM daily) SELECT visited_on, amount, average_amount FROM windowed WHERE rn >= 7;
explanation: Aggregate payments per day, calculate the 7-row window, then remove rows before a full 7-day window exists.
hints: Use ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW.
Filter to rn >= 7 for complete windows.
common_mistakes: Averaging raw customer rows instead of daily totals.
Using a running average instead of a fixed 7-day frame.
